It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 13, 2025 to Feb 3 and a pullback of 0.57 of them to the Mar 27 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−24%); a close over the wave-1 high (+57%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: SPY: below its 200-day
material.text: SPY, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Weekly: a deep wave 4
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Aug 4, 2025 to May 7 (+166%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback is under the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+18% to +7.9%), on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Aug 10 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−22%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: A hammer at a support area
material.text: On Nov 27 it dipped and closed near its high, leaving a long lower wick: buyers rejected the lows after a decline.
material.learn: A dip the close bought back: a small body over a tall lower shadow.

material.head: A failed breakdown from a 3-week base
material.text: It closed below the base's bottom but has climbed back inside: a failed breakdown, which traps sellers. 1 of the 3 closes from the break on held below the level it broke, and the break session closed 0.3 ATR past it on a 1-ATR range.
material.learn: A breakdown that climbs back inside its range traps sellers.

material.head: Sitting on support
material.text: Price sits on the Feb 13 low, the Mar 6 low and the Mar 31 low.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.
